messages.content: Random question — how was America discovered?

Short answer: Indigenous peoples lived in the Americas for many thousands of years before any European contact. Norse explorers (like Leif Erikson) reached parts of northeastern North America around 1000 CE, and Christopher Columbus’s 1492 voyage led to sustained European exploration and colonization.
